-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check. Verifies Google OAuth credentials and Calendar API connectivity.

calendar-list-calendars.name: calendar-list-calendars
calendar-list-calendars.description: List the user calendars (primary, secondary, shared). Returns curated rows { id, summary, timeZone, primary, accessRole, backgroundColor, ... }. Params: limit (1-250, def 100), cursor, fields?, includeRaw.

params.limit: Max calendars per page. Min 1, max 250, default 100.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Google response. Default false.

calendar-list-events.name: calendar-list-events
calendar-list-events.description: List events in a date range. Returns curated rows with attendee responseStatus, organizer, colorId, htmlLink, hangoutLink, recurrence. Params: startDate, endDate, calendarId?, limit (1-2500, def 25), cursor, timeZone?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.limit: Max events per page. Min 1, max 2500, default 25.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Google response. Default false.

calendar-get-event.name: calendar-get-event
calendar-get-event.description: Retrieve a single event by ID with full details (organizer, attendees with responseStatus, recurrence rule + parsed phrase, conferenceData, hangoutLink, htmlLink). Params: eventId, calendarId?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Google response. Default false.

calendar-search-events.name: calendar-search-events
calendar-search-events.description: Search events by free-text query (matches title, description, location, attendees). Returns curated rows with full attendee/organizer/recurrence/Meet details. Params: query, calendarId?, startDate?, endDate?, limit (1-2500, def 25), cursor, fields?, includeRaw.

params.limit: Max events per page. Min 1, max 2500, default 25.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Google response. Default false.

calendar-create-event.name: calendar-create-event
calendar-create-event.description: Create a calendar event. Supports recurrence (RRULE), Google Meet via addConference, attendee notifications via sendUpdates, custom reminders, and per-event color. Returns curated event with hangoutLink + htmlLink. Params: summary, start, end, plus optional calendarId, description, location, attendees, recurrence, addConference, sendUpdates, reminders, colorId.

params.start: ISO 8601 start. Use full timezone offset to avoid ambiguity (e.g. "2026-04-29T14:00:00+02:00").
params.timeZone: IANA timezone name (e.g. "Europe/Madrid"). Optional override. If omitted on recurring events, the handler resolves it from the user's Calendar settings automatically.
params.addConference: Generate a Google Meet link automatically. Default false.
params.sendUpdates: Notify attendees: "all" notifies everyone, "externalOnly" skips users in the same domain, "none" silent. Default "none".
params.reminders: Reminder overrides. {overrides:[{method:"popup"|"email", minutes}], useDefault:false}. If useDefault=true, calendar defaults are used.
params.colorId: Google Calendar color id (1-11) for the event tile.
params.attachments: Drive files to attach. Each item: { fileUrl: required, title?, mimeType?, iconLink?, fileId? }. fileUrl must be the Drive `alternateLink` (or webViewLink). The MCA forwards `supportsAttachments=true` to Google.
params.fields: Override default whitelist on the returned event.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Google response. Default false.

calendar-update-event.name: calendar-update-event
calendar-update-event.description: Patch an existing event. Attendee changes are explicit: addAttendees / removeAttendees merge with existing list, replaceAttendees overwrites everything (destructive). Supports updating recurrence, reminders, color, sendUpdates. Params: eventId required; all other fields optional. The handler issues at most ONE patch (events.get only runs when attendee merge is requested).

params.timeZone: IANA timezone name (e.g. "Europe/Madrid"). Optional override. If omitted when changing start/end of a recurring event, the handler resolves from the user's Calendar settings automatically.
params.recurrence: RRULE strings. Pass an empty array to clear recurrence.
params.removeAttendees: Emails to remove (existing attendees preserved otherwise).
params.replaceAttendees: Destructive: replaces the entire attendee list. Use with care — silently drops everyone not in this list.
params.sendUpdates: Notify attendees of the change. Default "none".
params.attachments: REPLACE the attachment list with this Drive file set. Pass an empty array to clear. The MCA forwards `supportsAttachments=true` to Google.

calendar-delete-event.name: calendar-delete-event
calendar-delete-event.description: Delete an event by ID. Optional sendUpdates controls whether attendees receive a cancellation notice. Returns the structured operation result — the renderer composes any user-facing message.

params.sendUpdates: Send cancellation notice to attendees. Default "none".

calendar-get-free-busy.name: calendar-get-free-busy
calendar-get-free-busy.description: Check free/busy across one or more calendars. Returns curated rows [{calendarId, busy: [{startISO, endISO, durationMinutes}], errors?}] — never the raw Google envelope. Params: startDate, endDate, calendarIds[], fields?, includeRaw.

params.calendarIds: Calendar IDs to query. Defaults to ["primary"].
params.timeZone: IANA timezone for response slots. Default: caller calendar timezone.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Google response. Default false.

calendar-respond-to-event.name: calendar-respond-to-event
calendar-respond-to-event.description: RSVP to a calendar event as the connected user. Reads the event's attendee list, locates the user (self), and patches their responseStatus to "accepted" / "declined" / "tentative" (optionally with a comment). If the user is not currently in the attendee list, they are added so the patch creates the entry. Returns {success, account, eventId, response, eventSummary}.

params.response: New responseStatus for the connected user.
params.comment: Optional reply comment shown next to the RSVP.
params.sendUpdates: Notify the organizer + other attendees of the RSVP. Default "none".

calendar-quick-add-event.name: calendar-quick-add-event
calendar-quick-add-event.description: Create an event from natural language ("Café con Antonio mañana 10am"). Google parses the text into title + date/time. Returns the curated event including the parsed start/end. Useful for low-effort scheduling. Note: only the title and time are inferred — for attendees, recurrence, location or Meet, use create-event instead.

params.sendUpdates: Notify potential attendees parsed from the text. Default "none".
params.fields: Override default whitelist on the returned event.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Google response. Default false.

calendar-create-focus-time.name: calendar-create-focus-time
calendar-create-focus-time.description: Block focus time on the user calendar. Created with eventType: "focusTime" + transparency: "opaque" so the slot is not all-day. Optionally auto-declines conflicting invitations and sets Chat status to "doNotDisturb". Returns the curated event.

params.autoDeclineMode: How to handle conflicting invitations during the focus time. Default "declineNone".
params.chatStatus: Chat presence during focus time. Default "doNotDisturb".

calendar-create-out-of-office.name: calendar-create-out-of-office
calendar-create-out-of-office.description: Mark the user as Out of Office. Created with eventType: "outOfOffice" + transparency: "opaque". By default declines all conflicting invitations with the provided message. NOT all-day; requires full ISO timestamps.

calendar-set-working-location.name: calendar-set-working-location
calendar-set-working-location.description: Mark the user working location for a date range. Created with eventType: "workingLocation" + visibility: "public" + transparency: "transparent" so it does not block free/busy. May be all-day (single day only) or timed.

params.officeLocation: When type=officeLocation: { buildingId?, deskId?, floorId?, floorSectionId?, label? }.

calendar-get-settings.name: calendar-get-settings
calendar-get-settings.description: Read the user Calendar preferences (timezone, locale, weekStart, dateFieldOrder, autoAddHangouts, useKeyboardShortcuts, ...). If `setting` is passed returns that single value; otherwise returns the full map keyed by setting id. Settings have global scope across the user's Calendar.

params.setting: Optional id of a single setting (e.g. "timezone", "locale", "weekStart").

calendar-get-colors.name: calendar-get-colors
calendar-get-colors.description: Return the official Google Calendar color palette: { event: {colorId: {background, foreground}}, calendar: {colorId: {background, foreground}}, updated }. Use this to validate event colorIds (1..11) at runtime instead of hardcoding hex values.

calendar-move-event.name: calendar-move-event
calendar-move-event.description: Move an event from one calendar to another. RESTRICTION: only `eventType: "default"` is movable — birthday/focusTime/outOfOffice/workingLocation/fromGmail events return an error. Returns the moved event in the destination calendar shape.

calendar-import-event.name: calendar-import-event
calendar-import-event.description: Import an external event (with iCalUID) into a calendar. Creates a private copy — distinct from create-event because it preserves the original UID for cross-system reconciliation. Use when the agent receives a `.ics` file or an event reference from another system.

calendar-list-instances.name: calendar-list-instances
calendar-list-instances.description: List instances of a recurring event with their override metadata. Returns rows with `originalStartTime` so the renderer can flag instances that were moved/modified vs. the recurring rule. Cursor pagination via `pageToken`.

name: Google Calendar
description: Manage Google Calendar: discover calendars, list/get/search events, create/update/delete events with recurrence + Meet + reminders + RSVP notifications, check availability

changelog.notes: Browse calendars, create and manage events with recurrence and Meet, RSVP, and check free-busy availability
